expectations.text: Creates user-requirement before system requirement (MBSE order)
expectations.evidence: Step 1 creates user-requirement 'Batch Export', Step 2 creates system requirement 'Batch Specification Export'. Correct MBSE order.

expectations.text: System requirement has derivedFrom relation to user requirement
expectations.evidence: Step 2 includes '* derivedFrom: [Batch Export](../UserRequirements.md#batch-export)' in Relations section.

expectations.text: Creates test-verification with verify relation to system requirement
expectations.evidence: Step 3 creates 'Batch Export Verification' with type: test-verification and '* verify: [Batch Specification Export](../Requirements.md#batch-specification-export)'.

expectations.text: Uses EARS pattern (shall statement) in requirement text
expectations.evidence: System requirement uses ubiquitous EARS: 'The system shall support exporting multiple specification files into a single archive file in a single operation.'

expectations.text: Uses reqvire add with heredoc or --content syntax
expectations.evidence: Used 'reqvire add requirements/... <<'EOF'' heredoc syntax for all three elements. Correct single-quoted EOF.

expectations.text: Includes reqvire validate as final step
expectations.evidence: Step 4 includes 'reqvire validate' along with lint, coverage, and format --fix.
